title: Registry entry curators/<name>.json (SKILL.md §5.1)
description: One JSON file per member digest in a registry repo. Cross-field rules checked by registry CI, not by this schema: name equals the file name; author_id is the GitHub numeric user id of the admission PR's opener and later PRs must come from that id; canonical(url) equals canonical(curator.url) of the digest's latest.json and canonical(BASE), and is unique in the registry; opml only when the digest's index.json has sources_opml; author_id, joined_at and delist_history are written only by the registry; delist_history intervals are never removed and only the last may have to = null.

name.description: equals the file name without .json; unique, never reused

url.description: the digest BASE; canonical(url) == canonical(latest.json curator.url) == canonical(BASE)

author.description: GitHub login, display only; identity is author_id

author_id.description: GitHub numeric user id of the admission PR opener; written by the registry at merge, immutable

opml.description: only when the digest set site.publish_sources: true

joined_at.description: written by the registry at merge

delist_history.description: written by the registry, oldest first; delisted iff the last interval has to = null; restore closes the open interval, never deletes

restore.description: set by the author only in a restore PR; removed by the registry at merge
